idea-plugin.name: Bisotun Flow Extractor
idea-plugin.description:
Bisotun Flow Extractor

Automate execution call flow extraction and related data model resolution for LLM context, documentation, and architectural analysis.

Key Features:

  • Multi-language Support: Full support for Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, React JSX, and React TSX.
  • Deep Execution Tracing: Traverses method calls across layers (controllers, services, repositories, and UI handlers).
  • Data Model Discovery: Extracts referenced DTOs, records, interfaces, and types across workspace files.
  • Clipboard Ready: Formats complete context with token counts directly into clean Markdown.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.0

  • Initial release with full Java, JS, TS, JSX, and TSX call flow extraction.
  • Support for cross-file model resolution and ESM imports.
  • Optimized linear parsing preventing UI freeze on large files.
